_comment: Per-package gzipped-size budgets in bytes. Measured against the ESM entry graph: dist/index.js plus every relative file it reaches, gzipped together, so a package that code-splits is still measured on what importing it costs. Tune up explicitly when a primitive batch lands; tune down when a refactor genuinely shrinks output. NOTE on @usemotif/icons: the dist barrel re-exports 1,933 lucide-derived glyphs; the budget reflects the full-barrel size, but real consumers tree-shake to ~100 B gz per imported icon (sideEffects: false guarantees it). Lowered once when lucide's aliases became re-exports of their target glyph instead of duplicate copies of it. NOTE on @usemotif/headless: raised twice while the package moved to a directive-free entry over a client chunk, first by 408 gzipped bytes and then by 356 more as that entry took over assembling all 17 compound namespaces. Both increases are the entry alone; across the second one the client chunk holding the components actually shrank by 146 bytes. Import cost fell at the same time, because a namespace built from plain bindings tree-shakes where an object of components did not: the Dialog-only and Tooltip-only targets in check-tree-shaking.mjs dropped by 14 and 24 percent. NOTE on @usemotif/headless, later: raised from 26100 to 28021 for date range selection on Calendar and DatePicker and for the shared menu level and submenu parts, net of ContextMenu's duplicate item, which went in the same change. Raised again from 28021 to 29885 for async Combobox states, promise toasts, the touch long-press, checkbox and radio menu items, and swipe-to-dismiss; useDrag itself lives in @usemotif/react and is not counted here. Raised again from 29885 to 31498 for the new Toggle and ToggleGroup. Raised again from 31498 to 33686 for TagsInput. Raised again from 33686 to 34100 for windowed option lists (spacers, scroll sync and highlight follow in the shared listbox rows). Raised again from 34100 to 34500 for RangeSlider pointer drag on the web track. NOTE on @usemotif/compiler-core: raised from 7374 to 7450 when four more state props (_invalid, _pressed, _focusWithin, _readOnly) joined its emit order and strip rules. Raised again from 7450 to 7550, and @usemotif/core from 19208 to 19400, for the group states (_groupHover, _groupFocus, _groupActive), the group marker, and responsive values inside state bags. @usemotif/core raised again from 19400 to 20300, and @usemotif/react from 28100 to 28200, for responsive styled() variant values (resolveResponsiveVariants). NOTE on usemotif: raised from 590 when both entries began re-exporting every name the two platform packages share (24 were missing), which the entry's own re-export list pays for. NOTE on @usemotif/react-native: raised from 27495 when Box gained keyframe animation (the stop sampler, CSS timing model and frame clock), an entry-graph growth of about 2.1 KB. NOTE on @usemotif/react: raised from 27909 to 28100 for Input adornments (startElement / endElement). Raised again from 28200 to 28600 for TextArea autoResize (field-sizing plus the measured fallback). NOTE on @usemotif/react, @usemotif/reset and @usemotif/migrate: these emit shared chunks alongside their entry, so their budgets were raised once to cover the whole graph rather than the entry fragment they used to be compared against.
